title: fragariastrum nitidum
intro: Fragariastrum nitidum, commonly known as the "Pink Strawberry Tree" or "Fragrant Strawberry Bush," is a species of flowering plant in the family Grossulariaceae. This plant is prized for its edible fruits, which are rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, offering numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Fragariastrum nitidum include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues and as a topical treatment for skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
